items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: McKinney told me, he said, 'You know, Quent, how would you like to join the band?' ... I never even dreamed that he would want me in the band. So I got in the car with him... I'm with Zack White and he wants to talk to me?

ctx.x: What was it? Before it got to be McKinney's, what was the band called?
McKinney's Cinco Septet. There were seven pieces.
